pairs.subject: agent-runtime-assembly
pairs.evidence: src/app/api/visual-gen/generate/status/route.ts:84 A 3D generation outlives a turn, but its job lives only in an in-process Map (tripo/trellis/hunyuan job stores). The caller, including the model through the pof_asset_generate_status MCP tool, keeps the jobId and polls it, so after a restart the handle points at nothing: the standard says to persist a durable row before returning and to serve a bounded projection instead.

techniques.evidence: src/app/api/visual-gen/generate/status/route.ts:84 The handle lives in the caller's context and the model polls it (tools/pof-mcp/src/tools/assets.ts:88). The job store is an in-memory Map (src/lib/visual-gen/tripo-job-store.ts:86), so a restart loses it. This is the 'naive integration' the technique names.

src/app/api/visual-gen/generate/status/route.ts:19 A job that was running when the process died comes back as 'not found', not as closed with an unknown outcome, even though a paid provider task may still deliver. The recover route only partly offsets this.

pairs.subject: agent-runtime-assembly
pairs.evidence: src/app/api/session-log/route.ts:46 Every CLI agent session for the project that is 'started' with no terminal row gets a definite 'cancelled' row with success=0 (src/lib/session-log-db.ts:109-110). That includes runs orphaned by an earlier crash or reload whose outcome nobody knows. The vocabulary started|completed|cancelled has no 'outcome unknown' state, so unknown is stored as a failure value.

techniques.evidence: src/app/api/session-log/route.ts:46 Open runs are closed as cancelled with success 0. The technique asks for an indeterminate closure instead of a definite failure-like verdict.

pairs.subject: agent-runtime-assembly
pairs.evidence: src/hooks/useChecklistCLI.ts:100 While an agent run is in flight, a second dispatch is dropped silently: the guard returns with no queue, injection or user signal, and the comment says the terminal itself drops dispatches while streaming. Input that arrives mid-run vanishes instead of joining the running unit at a model-call boundary.

techniques.evidence: src/hooks/useChecklistCLI.ts:100 A mid-run dispatch is discarded with no trace. useModuleCLI.sendPrompt (src/hooks/useModuleCLI.ts:185) dispatches without checking isRunning into a terminal that, by the comment at useChecklistCLI.ts:97, drops input while streaming.

declined.subject: agent-runtime-assembly
declined.reason: This is a TCP transport to a Blender addon, so it mostly belongs to the mcp-tools and subprocess side, not runtime assembly. It does hold create/poll Rodin generation jobs (src/lib/blender-mcp/service.ts, the poll_rodin_job_status mapping), which could bring bounded-projection into scope. I did not trace who polls those jobs or whether they are durable, so I can judge neither not-applicable nor deviation.
